_comment: Lane 6 wire contract between the browser extensions and the Hub. The Hub handlers are api_safari_ingest and api_safari_save in CM041 assistant_api/ical-server.py, shipped via vendor/cm041 in CM051. Both routes sit behind the Doctor proxy on :8089 and need Authorization: Bearer <token>. No em dashes in any file.

legacy_optional.html: string, kept for older extensions; the Hub never stores it

new_optional.text: string, readable plain text, at most 20480 characters, ONLY sent when the page passes the worth-it filter and is not skip-listed
new_optional.dwell_ms: integer, visible time on page in milliseconds

notes: The visit is sent at the existing 2.5 s debounce WITHOUT text. If the page is a revisit, text rides on that first send.

Otherwise, when visible dwell reaches the dwell threshold (default 15000 ms), the extension sends a SECOND POST with identical url and timestamp plus text and dwell_ms. The Hub treats same url+timestamp as the same visit (point id is uuid5 of url+timestamp).
Response 200 JSON: {ok, stored, id, summary_status}. summary_status is one of: queued, unsummarised, skipped_text.

optional.tags: array of short strings (user tags, max 20, 40 chars each)

notes: Explicit user action. The skip list does NOT apply, but the Hub sensitive-domain filter still does (returns skipped_sensitive).
Response 202 JSON: {ok, status: queued, id}. The summary is written asynchronously as a Knowledge item.
